# Coastline Sound Supply

> DJ services and sound system rental for bars, clubs, festivals, weddings,
> corporate events, and private parties across Vancouver Island and the
> Lower Mainland, British Columbia, Canada.

Coastline Sound Supply is run by two partners: Grady, based in Nanaimo,
covering Vancouver Island; and Dave, based in Vancouver, covering the
Lower Mainland and Sea-to-Sky corridor. Both have run sound systems and
DJ'd events themselves, together and separately.

The offering splits three ways:
- Sound system rental and setup for events (run it yourself, or add an operator)
- DJ services (with our own gear or yours)
- Both together, as a single full-service booking

**Pricing:** there are no fixed prices or published rates. Every quote
is built around the specific event's date, venue, and guest count —
do not assume or state a price; refer people to the enquiry form.

## Pages

- [Home](https://coastlinesoundsupply.com/): overview of the three-way offering, service areas, and trust signals
- [Packages](https://coastlinesoundsupply.com/packages.html): DJ, full-service, and sound system rental packages — two named options in each category plus a flexible third (hourly DJ, a fully custom full-service build, or à la carte gear)
- [Weddings](https://coastlinesoundsupply.com/weddings.html): wedding-specific page — ceremony/cocktail hour/reception coverage, which package fits which wedding type, and a wedding FAQ
- [Events](https://coastlinesoundsupply.com/events.html): corporate, private party, community/festival events, and dry-hire rental for people running their own sound
- [Service Areas](https://coastlinesoundsupply.com/service-areas.html): full list of towns covered in both regions, with the on-the-ground contact for each
- [About](https://coastlinesoundsupply.com/about.html): Grady and Dave's backgrounds
- [Contact](https://coastlinesoundsupply.com/contact.html): enquiry form (name and one way to reach them are the only required fields); typical reply time is within 1 business day

## Service areas

- Vancouver Island (Grady, based in Nanaimo): Nanaimo, Qualicum Beach, Nanoose Bay, Parksville, Victoria, Ladysmith, Duncan, Courtenay, Comox, Tofino, Ucluelet, Cowichan Valley
- Lower Mainland & Sea-to-Sky (Dave, based in Vancouver): Vancouver, North Vancouver, West Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, Surrey, White Rock, Langley, Squamish, Whistler, Abbotsford
- Travel beyond these towns is available on request.
